item.name: TCL 1.0HP Portable Air Conditioner with Remote Control, Auto Evaporation Penyaman Udara TAC-09CPA/SL
item.title: TCL 1.0HP Portable Air Conditioner with Remote Control, Auto Evaporation Penyaman Udara TAC-09CPA/SL
item.description:
FEATURES:
· Auto Evaporation
· Washable Filter
· Sleep Mode
· 24 Hour Timer
· Easy Window / Wall Connection

Ciri-ciri:
· Penyejatan Automatik
· Penapis Boleh Dicuci
· Mod Tidur
· Pemasa 24 Jam
· Sambungan Mudah ke Tingkap / Dinding

SPECIFICATIONS:
Model: TAC-09CPB/SL
Capacity: 1.0HP (9000 Btu)
Cooling Capacity(W): 2600
Cooling Input Power(W): 1000
Cooling Input Current(A): 4.5
EER (W/W): 2.6
Rated Power(W): 1220
Rated Current(A): 5.8
Indoor air flow  (Hi/Med/Lo)  (m3/h): 320/260
Dimension (W*H*D / mm): 280*290*675
Net Weight (kg): 18
Gross Weight (kg): 20.5
Colour: White
Gas: R410a
Warranty: 2 years + 5 years
